matter.AccessControl@1.4.name: Access Control
matter.AccessControl@1.4.title: Access Control
matter.AccessControl@1.4.description: The Access Control Cluster exposes a data model view of a Node s Access Control List ACL , which codifies the rules used to manage and enforce Access Control for the Node s endpoints and their associated cluster instances.

actions.name: ReviewFabricRestrictions
actions.description: This command signals to the service associated with the device vendor that the fabric administrator would like a review of the current restrictions on the accessing fabric.

matter.AccountLogin@1.4.name: Account Login
matter.AccountLogin@1.4.title: Account Login
matter.AccountLogin@1.4.description: This cluster provides commands that facilitate user account login on a Content App or a node. For example, a Content App running on a Video Player device, which is represented as an endpoint see TV Architecture , can use this cluster to help make the user account on the Content App match the user account on the Client.

actions.name: GetSetupPIN
actions.description: Upon receipt, the Content App checks if the account associated with the client Temp Account Identifier Rotating ID is the same acount that is active on the given Content App. If the accounts are the same, then the Content App includes the Setup PIN in the GetSetupPIN Response.

actions.name: Login
actions.description: Upon receipt, the Content App checks if the account associated with the client s Temp Account Identifier Rotating ID has a current active Setup PIN with the given value. If the Setup PIN is valid for the user account associated with the Temp Account Identifier, then the Content App MAY make that user account active.

actions.name: Logout
actions.description: The purpose of this command is to instruct the Content App to clear the current user account. This command SHOULD be used by clients of a Content App to indicate the end of a user session.

matter.Actions@1.4.name: Actions
matter.Actions@1.4.title: Actions
matter.Actions@1.4.description: This cluster provides a standardized way for a Node typically a Bridge, but could be any Node to expose action information.

actions.name: InstantAction
actions.description: This command triggers an action state change on the involved endpoints.

actions.name: InstantActionWithTransition
actions.description: This command triggers an action state change on the involved endpoints, with a specified time to transition from the current state to the new state.

actions.name: StartAction
actions.description: This command triggers the commencement of an action on the involved endpoints.

actions.name: StartActionWithDuration
actions.description: This command triggers the commencement of an action with a duration on the involved endpoints.

actions.name: StopAction
actions.description: This command stops the ongoing action on the involved endpoints.

actions.name: PauseAction
actions.description: This command pauses an ongoing action.

actions.name: PauseActionWithDuration
actions.description: This command pauses an ongoing action with a duration.

actions.name: ResumeAction
actions.description: This command resumes a previously paused action.

actions.name: EnableAction
actions.description: This command enables a certain action or automation.

actions.name: EnableActionWithDuration
actions.description: This command enables a certain action or automation with a duration.

actions.name: DisableAction
actions.description: This command disables a certain action or automation.

actions.name: DisableActionWithDuration
actions.description: This command disables a certain action or automation with a duration.

matter.ActivatedCarbonFilterMonitoring@1.description: Attributes and commands for monitoring activated carbon filters in a device

actions.description: This command is used by a current Administrator to instruct a Node to go into commissioning mode using enhanced commissioning method.

actions.name: OpenBasicCommissioningWindow

actions.name: RevokeCommissioning
actions.description: This command is used by a current Administrator to instruct a Node to revoke any active Open Commissioning Window or Open Basic Commissioning Window command.

matter.AirQuality@1.4.title: Air Quality
matter.AirQuality@1.4.description: Attributes for reporting air quality classification

matter.ApplicationBasic@1.4.name: Application Basic
matter.ApplicationBasic@1.4.title: Application Basic

actions.description: Upon receipt on a Video Player endpoint this SHALL stop the specified application if it is running.

actions.name: HideApp
actions.description: Upon receipt on a Video Player endpoint this SHALL hide the specified application if it is running and visible.

matter.AudioOutput@1.4.name: Audio Output
matter.AudioOutput@1.4.title: Audio Output
matter.AudioOutput@1.4.description: This cluster provides an interface for controlling the Output on a media device such as a TV.

actions.name: RenameOutput

actions.name: EnableDisableAlarm

matter.CarbonDioxideConcentrationMeasure.name: Carbon Dioxide Concentration Measurement
matter.CarbonDioxideConcentrationMeasure.title: Carbon Dioxide Concentration Measurement
matter.CarbonDioxideConcentrationMeasure.description: Attributes for reporting carbon dioxide concentration measurements

matter.CarbonMonoxideConcentrationMeasur.name: Carbon Monoxide Concentration Measurement
matter.CarbonMonoxideConcentrationMeasur.title: Carbon Monoxide Concentration Measurement
matter.CarbonMonoxideConcentrationMeasur.description: Attributes for reporting carbon monoxide concentration measurements

matter.Channel@1.4.name: Channel
matter.Channel@1.4.title: Channel
matter.Channel@1.4.description: This cluster provides an interface for controlling the current Channel on a device.

actions.name: ChangeChannel
actions.description: Change the channel on the media player to the channel case-insensitive exact matching the value passed as an argument.

actions.name: ChangeChannelByNumber
actions.description: Change the channel on the media plaeyer to the channel with the given Number in the ChannelList attribute.

actions.name: SkipChannel
actions.description: This command provides channel up and channel down functionality, but allows channel index jumps of size Count. When the value of the increase or decrease is larger than the number of channels remaining in the given direction, then the behavior SHALL be to return to the beginning or end of the channel list and continue. For example, if the current channel is at index 0 and count value of -1 is given, then the current channel should change to the last channel.

actions.name: GetProgramGuide
actions.description: This command retrieves the program guide. It accepts several filter parameters to return specific schedule and program information from a content app. The command shall receive in response a ProgramGuideResponse.

actions.name: RecordProgram
actions.description: Record a specific program or series when it goes live. This functionality enables DVR recording features.

actions.name: CancelRecordProgram
actions.description: Cancel recording for a specific program or series.

matter.Chime@1.4.name: Chime
matter.Chime@1.4.title: Chime
matter.Chime@1.4.description: This cluster provides facilities to configure and play Chime sounds, such as those used in a doorbell.

actions.name: PlayChimeSound
actions.description: PlayChimeSound

matter.ColorControl@1.4.name: Color Control
matter.ColorControl@1.4.title: Color Control
matter.ColorControl@1.4.description: Attributes and commands for controlling the color properties of a color-capable light.

actions.name: MoveToHue
actions.description: Move to specified hue.

actions.name: MoveHue
actions.description: Move hue up or down at specified rate.

actions.name: StepHue
actions.description: Step hue up or down by specified size at specified rate.

actions.name: MoveToSaturation
actions.description: Move to specified saturation.

actions.name: MoveSaturation
actions.description: Move saturation up or down at specified rate.

actions.name: StepSaturation
actions.description: Step saturation up or down by specified size at specified rate.

actions.name: MoveToHueAndSaturation
actions.description: Move to hue and saturation.

actions.name: MoveToColor
actions.description: Move to specified color.

actions.name: MoveColor
actions.description: Moves the color.

actions.name: StepColor
actions.description: Steps the lighting to a specific color.

actions.name: MoveToColorTemperature
actions.description: Move to a specific color temperature.

matter.CommissionerControl@1.4.name: Commissioner Control
matter.CommissionerControl@1.4.title: Commissioner Control
matter.CommissionerControl@1.4.description: Supports the ability for clients to request the commissioning of themselves or other nodes onto a fabric which the cluster server can commission onto.

actions.name: RequestCommissioningApproval
actions.description: This command is sent by a client to request approval for a future CommissionNode call.

actions.name: CommissionNode
actions.description: This command is sent by a client to request that the server begins commissioning a previously approved request.

matter.ContentAppObserver@1.4.name: Content App Observer
matter.ContentAppObserver@1.4.title: Content App Observer
matter.ContentAppObserver@1.4.description: This cluster provides an interface for sending targeted commands to an Observer of a Content App on a Video Player device such as a Streaming Media Player, Smart TV or Smart Screen. The cluster server for Content App Observer is implemented by an endpoint that communicates with a Content App, such as a Casting Video Client. The cluster client for Content App Observer is implemented by a Content App endpoint. A Content App is informed of the NodeId of an Observer when a binding is set on the Content App. The Content App can then send the ContentAppMessage to the Observer server cluster , and the Observer responds with a ContentAppMessageResponse.

actions.name: ContentAppMessage
actions.description: Upon receipt, the data field MAY be parsed and interpreted. Message encoding is specific to the Content App. A Content App MAY when possible read attributes from the Basic Information Cluster on the Observer and use this to determine the Message encoding.

matter.ContentControl@1.4.name: Content Control
matter.ContentControl@1.4.title: Content Control
matter.ContentControl@1.4.description: This cluster is used for managing the content control including parental control settings on a media device such as a TV, or Set-top Box.

actions.name: UpdatePIN
actions.description: The purpose of this command is to update the PIN used for protecting configuration of the content control settings. Upon success, the old PIN SHALL no longer work. The PIN is used to ensure that only the Node or User with the PIN code can make changes to the Content Control settings, for example, turn off Content Controls or modify the ScreenDailyTime. The PIN is composed of a numeric string of up to 6 human readable characters displayable . Upon receipt of this command, the media device SHALL check if the OldPIN field of this command is the same as the current PIN. If the PINs are the same, then the PIN code SHALL be set to NewPIN. Otherwise a response with InvalidPINCode error status SHALL be returned. The media device MAY provide a default PIN to the User via an out of band mechanism. For security reasons, it is recommended that a client encourage the user to update the PIN from its default value when performing configuration of the Content Control settings exposed by this cluster. The ResetPIN command can also be used to obtain the default PIN.

actions.name: ResetPIN
actions.description: The purpose of this command is to reset the PIN. If this command is executed successfully, a ResetPINResponse command with a new PIN SHALL be returned.

actions.name: Enable
actions.description: The purpose of this command is to turn on the Content Control feature on a media device. On receipt of the Enable command, the media device SHALL set the Enabled attribute to TRUE.

actions.name: Disable
actions.description: The purpose of this command is to turn off the Content Control feature on a media device. On receipt of the Disable command, the media device SHALL set the Enabled attribute to FALSE.

actions.name: AddBonusTime
actions.description: The purpose of this command is to add the extra screen time for the user. If a client with Operate privilege invokes this command, the media device SHALL check whether the PINCode passed in the command matches the current PINCode value. If these match, then the RemainingScreenTime attribute SHALL be increased by the specified BonusTime value. If the PINs do not match, then a response with InvalidPINCode error status SHALL be returned, and no changes SHALL be made to RemainingScreenTime. If a client with Manage privilege or greater invokes this command, the media device SHALL ignore the PINCode field and directly increase the RemainingScreenTime attribute by the specified BonusTime value. A server that does not support the PM feature SHALL respond with InvalidPINCode to clients that only have Operate privilege unless It has been provided with the PIN value to expect via an out of band mechanism, and The client has provided a PINCode that matches the expected PIN value.

actions.name: SetScreenDailyTime
actions.description: The purpose of this command is to set the ScreenDailyTime attribute. On receipt of the SetScreenDailyTime command, the media device SHALL set the ScreenDailyTime attribute to the ScreenTime value.

actions.name: BlockUnratedContent
actions.description: The purpose of this command is to specify whether programs with no Content rating must be blocked by this media device. On receipt of the BlockUnratedContent command, the media device SHALL set the BlockUnrated attribute to TRUE.

actions.name: UnblockUnratedContent
actions.description: The purpose of this command is to specify whether programs with no Content rating must be blocked by this media device. On receipt of the UnblockUnratedContent command, the media device SHALL set the BlockUnrated attribute to FALSE.

actions.name: SetOnDemandRatingThreshold
actions.description: The purpose of this command is to set the OnDemandRatingThreshold attribute. On receipt of the SetOnDemandRatingThreshold command, the media device SHALL check if the Rating field is one of values present in the OnDemandRatings attribute. If not, then a response with InvalidRating error status SHALL be returned.

actions.name: SetScheduledContentRatingThreshold
actions.description: The purpose of this command is to set ScheduledContentRatingThreshold attribute. On receipt of the SetScheduledContentRatingThreshold command, the media device SHALL check if the Rating field is one of values present in the ScheduledContentRatings attribute. If not, then a response with InvalidRating error status SHALL be returned.

matter.ContentLauncher@1.4.name: Content Launcher
matter.ContentLauncher@1.4.title: Content Launcher
matter.ContentLauncher@1.4.description: This cluster provides an interface for launching content on a media player device such as a TV or Speaker.

actions.name: LaunchContent
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL launch the specified content with optional search criteria.

actions.name: LaunchURL
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL launch content from the specified URL.

matter.DemandResponseLoadControl@1.4.name: Demand Response Load Control
matter.DemandResponseLoadControl@1.4.title: Demand Response Load Control
matter.DemandResponseLoadControl@1.4.description: This cluster provides an interface to the functionality of Smart Energy Demand Response and Load Control.

actions.name: RegisterLoadControlProgramRequest
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL insert a new LoadControlProgramStruct into LoadControlPrograms, or if the ProgramID matches an existing LoadControlProgramStruct, then the provider SHALL be updated with the provided values.

actions.name: UnregisterLoadControlProgramRequest
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL remove a the LoadControlProgramStruct from LoadControlPrograms with the matching ProgramID.

actions.name: AddLoadControlEventRequest
actions.description: On receipt of the AddLoadControlEventsRequest command, the server SHALL add a load control event.

actions.name: RemoveLoadControlEventRequest
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL remove the LoadControlEventStruct with the matching EventID from LoadEventPrograms.

actions.name: ClearLoadControlEventsRequest
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL clear all the load control events.

matter.Descriptor@1.4.name: Descriptor
matter.Descriptor@1.4.title: Descriptor
matter.Descriptor@1.4.description: The Descriptor Cluster is meant to replace the support from the Zigbee Device Object ZDO for describing a node, its endpoints and clusters.

matter.DeviceEnergyManagement@1.4.name: Device Energy Management
matter.DeviceEnergyManagement@1.4.title: Device Energy Management
matter.DeviceEnergyManagement@1.4.description: This cluster allows a client to manage the power draw of a device. An example of such a client could be an Energy Management System EMS which controls an Energy Smart Appliance ESA .

actions.name: PowerAdjustRequest
actions.description: Allows a client to request an adjustment in the power consumption of an ESA for a specified duration.

actions.name: CancelPowerAdjustRequest
actions.description: Allows a client to cancel an ongoing PowerAdjustmentRequest operation.

actions.name: StartTimeAdjustRequest
actions.description: Allows a client to adjust the start time of a Forecast sequence that has not yet started operation i.e. where the current Forecast StartTime is in the future .

actions.name: PauseRequest
actions.description: Allows a client to temporarily pause an operation and reduce the ESAs energy demand.

actions.name: ResumeRequest
actions.description: Allows a client to cancel the PauseRequest command and enable earlier resumption of operation.

actions.name: ModifyForecastRequest
actions.description: Allows a client to modify a Forecast within the limits allowed by the ESA.

actions.name: RequestConstraintBasedForecast
actions.description: Allows a client to ask the ESA to recompute its Forecast based on power and time constraints.

actions.name: CancelRequest
actions.description: Allows a client to request cancellation of a previous adjustment request in a StartTimeAdjustRequest, ModifyForecastRequest or RequestConstraintBasedForecast command

matter.DeviceEnergyManagementMode@1.4.name: Device Energy Management Mode
matter.DeviceEnergyManagementMode@1.4.title: Device Energy Management Mode
matter.DeviceEnergyManagementMode@1.4.description: Attributes and commands for selecting a mode from a list of supported options.

actions.name: ChangeToMode

matter.DiagnosticLogs@1.4.name: Diagnostic Logs
matter.DiagnosticLogs@1.4.title: Diagnostic Logs

actions.name: RetrieveLogsRequest

matter.DishwasherAlarm@1.4.name: Dishwasher Alarm

matter.DishwasherAlarm@1.4.description: Attributes and commands for configuring the Dishwasher alarm.

matter.DishwasherMode@1.4.title: Dishwasher Mode
matter.DishwasherMode@1.4.description: Attributes and commands for selecting a mode from a list of supported options.

actions.name: ChangeToMode
actions.description: This command is used to change device modes. On receipt of this command the device SHALL respond with a ChangeToModeResponse command.

matter.DoorLock@1.4.description: An interface to a generic way to secure a door

actions.name: UnlockDoor

actions.name: SetHolidaySchedule

actions.name: GetHolidaySchedule

actions.name: ClearHolidaySchedule
actions.description: Clears the holiday schedule or all holiday schedules.

actions.name: SetUser

actions.name: GetUser

actions.name: ClearUser

actions.name: UnboltDoor

actions.name: ClearAliroReaderConfig

matter.EcosystemInformation@1.4.title: Ecosystem Information
matter.EcosystemInformation@1.4.description: Provides extended device information for all the logical devices represented by a Bridged Node.

matter.FormaldehydeConcentrationMeasurem.name: Formaldehyde Concentration Measurement
matter.FormaldehydeConcentrationMeasurem.title: Formaldehyde Concentration Measurement
matter.FormaldehydeConcentrationMeasurem.description: Attributes for reporting formaldehyde concentration measurements

actions.name: ArmFailSafe

actions.name: SetRegulatoryConfig

actions.name: CommissioningComplete

actions.name: Play
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL play media.

actions.name: Pause
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL pause media.

actions.name: Stop
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL stop media. User experience is context-specific. This will often navigate the user back to the location where media was originally launched.

actions.name: StartOver
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL Start Over with the current media playback item.

actions.name: Previous
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL cause the handler to be invoked for Previous . User experience is context-specific. This will often Go back to the previous media playback item.

actions.name: Next
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL cause the handler to be invoked for Next . User experience is context-specific. This will often Go forward to the next media playback item.

actions.name: Rewind
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL Rewind through media. Different Rewind speeds can be used on the TV based upon the number of sequential calls to this function. This is to avoid needing to define every speed now multiple fast, slow motion, etc .

actions.name: FastForward
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL Advance through media. Different FF speeds can be used on the TV based upon the number of sequential calls to this function. This is to avoid needing to define every speed now multiple fast, slow motion, etc .

actions.name: SkipForward
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL Skip forward in the media by the given number of seconds, using the data as follows

actions.name: SkipBackward
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL Skip backward in the media by the given number of seconds, using the data as follows

actions.name: Seek
actions.description: Upon receipt, this SHALL Skip backward in the media by the given number of seconds, using the data as follows

actions.name: ActivateAudioTrack
actions.description: Upon receipt, the server SHALL set the active Audio Track to the one identified by the TrackID in the Track catalog for the streaming media. If the TrackID does not exist in the Track catalog, OR does not correspond to the streaming media OR no media is being streamed at the time of receipt of this command, the server will return an error status of INVALID ARGUMENT.

actions.name: ActivateTextTrack
actions.description: Upon receipt, the server SHALL set the active Text Track to the one identified by the TrackID in the Track catalog for the streaming media. If the TrackID does not exist in the Track catalog, OR does not correspond to the streaming media OR no media is being streamed at the time of receipt of this command, the server SHALL return an error status of INVALID ARGUMENT.

actions.name: DeactivateTextTrack
actions.description: If a Text Track is active i.e. being displayed , upon receipt of this command, the server SHALL stop displaying it.

actions.name: Off
actions.description: On receipt of this command, a device SHALL enter its Off state. This state is device dependent, but it is recommended that it is used for power off or similar functions. On receipt of the Off command, the OnTime attribute SHALL be set to 0.

actions.name: On
actions.description: On receipt of this command, a device SHALL enter its On state. This state is device dependent, but it is recommended that it is used for power on or similar functions. On receipt of the On command, if the value of the OnTime attribute is equal to 0, the device SHALL set the OffWaitTime attribute to 0.

actions.name: Toggle
actions.description: On receipt of this command, if a device is in its Off state it SHALL enter its On state. Otherwise, if it is in its On state it SHALL enter its Off state. On receipt of the Toggle command, if the value of the OnOff attribute is equal to FALSE and if the value of the OnTime attribute is equal to 0, the device SHALL set the OffWaitTime attribute to 0. If the value of the OnOff attribute is equal to TRUE, the OnTime attribute SHALL be set to 0.

actions.name: OnWithRecallGlobalScene

actions.name: OnWithTimedOff

matter.UnitTesting@1.4.name: Unit Testing
matter.UnitTesting@1.4.title: Unit Testing
matter.UnitTesting@1.4.description: The Test Cluster is meant to validate the generated code

actions.name: Test
actions.description: Simple command without any parameters and without a specific response. To aid in unit testing, this command will re-initialize attribute storage to defaults.

actions.name: TestNotHandled
actions.description: Simple command without any parameters and without a specific response not handled by the server

actions.name: TestSpecific
actions.description: Simple command without any parameters and with a specific response

actions.name: TestUnknownCommand
actions.description: Simple command that should not be added to the server.

actions.name: TestAddArguments
actions.description: Command that takes two arguments and returns their sum.

actions.name: TestSimpleArgumentRequest
actions.description: Command that takes an argument which is bool

actions.name: TestStructArrayArgumentRequest
actions.description: Command that takes various arguments that are arrays, including an array of structs which have a list member.

actions.name: TestStructArgumentRequest
actions.description: Command that takes an argument which is struct. The response echoes the b field of the single arg.

actions.name: TestNestedStructArgumentRequest
actions.description: Command that takes an argument which is nested struct. The response echoes the b field of ar1.c.

actions.name: TestListStructArgumentRequest
actions.description: Command that takes an argument which is a list of structs. The response returns false if there is some struct in the list whose b field is false, and true otherwise including if the list is empty .

actions.name: TestListInt8UArgumentRequest
actions.description: Command that takes an argument which is a list of INT8U. The response returns false if the list contains a 0 in it, true otherwise including if the list is empty .

actions.name: TestNestedStructListArgumentRequest
actions.description: Command that takes an argument which is a Nested Struct List. The response returns false if there is some struct in arg1 either directly in arg1.c or in the arg1.d list whose b field is false, and true otherwise.

actions.name: TestListNestedStructListArgumentRequest
actions.description: Command that takes an argument which is a list of Nested Struct List. The response returns false if there is some struct in arg1 either directly in as the c field of an entry d list of an entry whose b field is false, and true otherwise including if the list is empty .

actions.name: TestListInt8UReverseRequest
actions.description: Command that takes an argument which is a list of INT8U and expects a response that reverses the list.

actions.name: TestEnumsRequest
actions.description: Command that sends a vendor id and an enum. The server is expected to echo them back.

actions.name: TestNullableOptionalRequest
actions.description: Command that takes an argument which is nullable and optional. The response returns a boolean indicating whether the argument was present, if that s true a boolean indicating whether the argument was null, and if that false the argument it received.

actions.name: TestComplexNullableOptionalRequest
actions.description: Command that takes various arguments which can be nullable and/or optional. The response returns information about which things were received and what their state was.

actions.name: SimpleStructEchoRequest
actions.description: Command that takes an argument which is a struct. The response echoes the struct back.

actions.name: TimedInvokeRequest
actions.description: Command that just responds with a success status if the timed invoke conditions are met.

actions.name: TestSimpleOptionalArgumentRequest
actions.description: Command that takes an optional argument which is bool. It responds with a success value if the optional is set to any value.

actions.name: TestEmitTestEventRequest
actions.description: Command that takes identical arguments to the fields of the TestEvent and logs the TestEvent to the buffer. Command returns an event ID as the response.

actions.name: TestEmitTestFabricScopedEventRequest
actions.description: Command that takes identical arguments to the fields of the TestFabricScopedEvent and logs the TestFabricScopedEvent to the buffer. Command returns an event ID as the response.

actions.name: TestBatchHelperRequest
actions.description: Command that responds after sleepBeforeResponseTimeMs with an octet string the size requested with fillCharacter.

actions.name: TestSecondBatchHelperRequest
actions.description: Second command that responds after sleepBeforeResponseTimeMs with an octet string the size requested with fillCharacter.

actions.name: StringEchoRequest
actions.description: Command that takes an argument which is an octet string. The response echoes the string back. If the string is large then it would require a session that supports large payloads.

actions.name: GlobalEchoRequest
actions.description: Command that takes arguments that are global structs/enums and the response just echoes them back.

actions.name: TestDifferentVendorMeiRequest
actions.description: Command having a different MEI vendor ID than the cluster. Also emits TestDifferentVendorMeiEvent.
